notes: The relation-composition argument avoids the documented pitfall, but the proof unjustifiably calls V_{n+2}(z) a neighborhood. No topology or neighborhood compatibility is assumed. For example, give X={0}∪{1/m:m≥1} its usual T3 topology, well-order it as 0≺1≺1/2≺⋯, and set every V_k=Δ_X. All stated relation hypotheses hold, but A_n(x)={x}, and every neighborhood of 0 meets infinitely many family members. The claimed topological discreteness therefore requires an additional hypothesis.
